text:
Maya: Quick thread — want to book a 45m inference roundtable next week to go over latency/cost dashboards + recent benchmark readouts. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:45, Wed 15:00-15:45, Fri 09:00-09:45. Agenda draft: 1) perf-bot summary, 2) KV-cache + quantization results (Ciara), 3) routing / fallback SLA impact (Raj), 4) rollout/runbook. Reply with a preferred slot or say 'no'.

Tom: Tue 10 works for me. Can we have a short pre-read (dashboards + CSV)?

Ciara: I can present the KV-cache experiment. Prefer Wed or Fri though. Will drop slides by EOD Mon.

Ellen: Wed 15:00 ok for me. Can we make it 60m instead of 45? There's a few regressions to walk through.

Raj: Wed for me too. Please include A/B routing perf data in the pre-read — I'll post results.

perf-bot: Automated benchmark report uploaded: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/commit/af3b2c4/perf/latency-cost-2026-12-01. Summary: p95=188ms (±12), token-cost Δ=-6.5% (quantized). ci-tag: qkv-opt-3

Maya: Thanks — seems Wed 15:00 wins. Ellen do you want the full hour? I can block 3-4pm if folks agree. Updated agenda: (1) perf-bot summary (5m) (2) Ciara kv/quant results (20m) (3) Raj routing/A-B results (15m) (4) rollout/runbook + next steps (20m). If ok I'll send invite for Wed 3-4pm.

Tom: +1 to 3-4pm. I'll add a checklist for pre-reads: dashboards link + perf CSVs + sampling config.

Raj: Note — include beam size, batch config, and kernel/quant flags in pre-read. I'll post the A/B comparison by Tue noon.

Ciara: Got it, will attach slides + a small config diff. :thumbsup:

Maya: Great — booking invite now. If anyone absolutely can't make, DM me and we'll record and follow up async.
